sloka: मनोज्ञा यत्र ता दृष्टा वारमुख्याः स्वलंकृताः ।दृष्ट्वा एव च ततो विप्रम् आयान्तम् हृष्ट मानसाः ॥१-१०-२५॥
transliteration: manojñā yatra tā dṛṣṭā vāramukhyāḥ svalaṁkṛtāḥ ।dṛṣṭvā eva ca tato vipram āyāntam hṛṣṭa mānasāḥ ॥1-10-25॥

translations.english: All of them were rejoiced on seeing the brahmin approaching them, came nearer to him and said:
